svg.title: Two plans from the same start: a straight line that falls short, and a curve worked back from the vision.
svg.desc: Two lines over the same time, both starting from today at the lower left. The vision sits at the upper right, highlighted. The first line, planned step by step, climbs in a straight line and ends, on time, about halfway up. The gap between its end and the vision is shaded: still short. The second, planned from the destination, stays low at first, while new investments come online, crosses the straight line about halfway along, then climbs steeply. It is planned to reach the vision.
svg.text: slow while new investments come online
